CVE-2026-121757.description: Converting crafted CP949 input to UTF-8 character encoding and ignoring invalid characters, in the GNU C Library version 2.1 or later may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash. When the CP949 decoder encounters an invalid input byte sequence like '\xa2\xe8' it ends up advancing the pointer tracking the read buffer position twice. If //IGNORE is set on the destination encoding and this sequence is at the end of the input buffer, the decoder may then end up reading past the bounds of the input buffer. To exploit this, the target iconv function needs to set //IGNORE on the destination of the conversion and the input and encoding needs to be attacker controlled.

CVE-2026-121758.description: Converting crafted ISO-2022-CN-EXT input to UTF-8 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.2 through 2.44 may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash. When the ISO-2022-CN-EXT decoder encounters an invalid input byte sequence like '\x0e' it ends up advancing the pointer tracking the read buffer position twice. If this sequence is at the end of the input buffer, the decoder may then end up reading past the bounds of the input buffer. To exploit this, the input and encoding needs to be attacker controlled.

CVE-2026-124024.description: Converting crafted input from UCS-4 to IBM1390 or IBM1399 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.3.3 and later may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash. When converting from UCS-4, these encoders may encounter a combining base such as U+00E6 and jump ahead by 4 bytes to check the next UCS-4 code point. The check for end of buffer however does not account for this, which may result in a buffer overread if the following code point has less than 4 bytes remaining. Exploitation of this bug not only requires attacker control of input and encoding, but also strict control over layout of the input in memory.

CVE-2026-129511.description: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs vulnerability in the FileAppender, RollingFileAppender, UdpAppender and SmtpAppender of Apache log4net. Characters the configured encoding could not represent were converted by that encoding's best-fit fallback, which turns fullwidth characters such as U+FF1C, U+FF1E and U+FF02 into <, > and ". The conversion happened after XmlLayout or XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J had escaped the text, so a party whose data reaches a log message could forge complete log events in an XML log, for example a fake audit entry. On .NET Framework this needs no configuration where the ANSI code page is single-byte, since that is the default encoding; on .NET it needs a configured single-byte encoding such as ISO-8859-1. This is the best-fit conversion described by the WorstFit research. This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-129512.description: Improper Neutralization of Null Byte or NUL Character vulnerability in the AdoNetAppender of Apache log4net. Text parameters were bound unchanged, so a NUL character or an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate reached the database as it was. A database that refuses such a value, such as PostgreSQL, rejected the insert and the event was lost; only the first such loss per appender was reported. A party whose data reaches a log message could suppress that event. This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-129891.description: IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl let an on-path attacker choose the installed public suffix list because update_self_from_url fetches it over cleartext HTTP with no integrity check. Called with no argument, as the module's documentation shows, the updater fetches the list from the `http://` address in the URL constant and checks only that the request succeeded, with no signature or digest over the response. The lines that come back are written into the module's own source file as the built-in list. An attacker on the network path when the updater runs chooses the suffix boundary the module reports to every caller on the host, and that answer persists in the installed module until it is reinstalled. Dropping one rule makes the hostname check in IO::Socket::SSL accept a wildcard certificate that spans the whole public suffix that rule named.

CVE-2026-129892.description: IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl allow code injection via a fetched list line that closes the built-in data heredoc when update_self_from_url rewrites the module's source. The rewrite copies the module's source down to the built-in list's heredoc and appends each fetched line below it. Nothing checks that a line looks like a domain. A line that is not a comment loses only what follows a `//` and its trailing whitespace, so a line reading END_BUILTIN_DATA is appended as it stands and ends the data block in the rewritten file. Every fetched line after it is Perl. Arbitrary Perl runs in every process that loads IO::Socket::SSL, which loads this module unconditionally, until the file is reinstalled. The attacker must control the fetched list, through the cleartext default URL or a caller-supplied one, and the updater must run with write access to the installed module.

CVE-2026-130600.description: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in BdThemes Element Pack Elementor Addons bdthemes-element-pack-lite allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects Element Pack Elementor Addons: from n/a through 10.0.9.

CVE-2026-131842.description: Poppler pdfdetach 24.03.0 through 26.11.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in utils/pdfdetach.cc that allows attackers to write files outside the output directory by bypassing a string-prefix containment check. Attackers can craft PDFs with embedded file names containing '..' sequences or absolute paths, so -saveall or -savefile extraction creates or overwrites files with the invoking user's privileges.

CVE-2026-131843.description: Poppler pdftohtml through 26.11.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in HtmlLink::getLinkStart() in utils/HtmlLinks.cc that writes PDF link annotation URIs into href attributes without escaping in HTML output modes. Attackers can craft a PDF whose /URI entry contains a double quote followed by HTML markup or event handlers to execute script in browsers viewing the generated HTML.

CVE-2026-131844.description: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in the libcurl-based remote file loader that trusts unvalidated HEAD Content-Length values in CurlCachedFileLoader::init(). Malicious HTTP servers can return an enormous Content-Length so CachedFile resizes its chunk cache accordingly, aborting pdfinfo or PDFDocFactory-based applications with std::bad_alloc for denial of service.

CVE-2026-131845.description: Poppler 21.01.0 through 26.11.0 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in FormWidgetSignature::signDocument() that allows local attackers to obtain valid signatures over altered content. Attackers with write access to the output file or directory can overwrite or swap the PDF between writing and hashing, causing the signer's key to sign attacker-controlled content.

CVE-2026-131846.description: Poppler 0.76.1 through 26.11.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SplashOutputDev::iccTransform() that allows attackers to write out of bounds when rendering in splashModeDeviceN8. Attackers can supply a PDF with an ICCBased image whose alternate is DeviceN, causing getDeviceNLine() to overflow the per-row buffer, crashing the renderer and corrupting heap memory.

CVE-2026-131847.description: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in NSSCryptoSignBackend.cc that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed CMS arena memory during repeated signature verification. Attackers can supply a signed PDF embedding the signer certificate to crash applications or pdfsig runs validating multiple signatures, or cause incorrect certificate validation results.

CVE-2026-131848.description: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadMultiVars() that allows malicious PLCs to overflow client buffers via unchecked DataLength fields. Attackers controlling or impersonating a PLC can return crafted ReadVar responses to Cli_ReadMultiVars() callers, writing up to 65535 bytes per item to corrupt memory and crash clients.

CVE-2026-131849.description: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadSZL() that allows malicious PLCs to overwrite client memory by sending oversized multi-slice SZL responses. A rogue or impersonated PLC can keep flagging more data with attacker-controlled DLen slices, overflowing the 65536-byte opData buffer via Cli_ReadSZL() and Cli_ReadSZLList(), crashing the client and corrupting heap memory.

CVE-2026-131850.description: ILIAS 11.0 before 11.6 contains an sql injection vulnerability in RegistrationCodeRepository::getCodesData() that concatenates unvalidated sort fields into an ORDER BY clause. Authenticated users with read access to the Authentication and Registration administration node can supply SQL expressions as the sort parameter to extract database contents via boolean-based inference.

CVE-2026-131851.description: ILIAS before 9.25, 10.13, and 11.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in ilPRGAssignmentFilter::toConditions() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through the StudyProgramme members list Name and Status filters. Attackers holding only the OrgUnit permission to view members can break out of LIKE literals and execute stacked statements, such as overwriting the root password hash to gain administrative control.

CVE-2026-131852.description: OwnTracks Recorder before 1.0.5 contains a format string vulnerability in json_response() and related output functions that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code by storing a malicious tid value. Attackers can publish locations via POST /pub or MQTT with printf specifiers in tid, then read them back through GET /api/0/last to leak addresses and write memory.

CVE-2026-131853.description: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_ssh() in src/dissectors/ec_ssh.c that copies a peer-supplied data_len without checking remaining packet bytes. A malicious SSHv1 client or server in an intercepted session can send a short packet with a large data_len to disclose up to 64 bytes of adjacent heap memory through captured credentials in the interface and log.

CVE-2026-131854.description: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_mysql() in src/dissectors/ec_mysql.c that copies seed and password bytes without bounds checks. A malicious MySQL server or client can send truncated greeting or login packets to leak adjacent heap memory through hex-encoded output in the interface and log.

CVE-2026-131855.description: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_vnc() in src/dissectors/ec_vnc.c that checks total packet length instead of remaining bytes. A malicious VNC server can send the authentication type and challenge in one short packet to leak up to 3 bytes of adjacent heap memory via the logged challenge.

CVE-2026-131856.description: Pika before 1.5.0 contains an uncontrolled resource allocation vulnerability that allows malicious brokers to exhaust client memory by declaring oversized frame payloads. Attackers can send frame headers declaring up to 4 GiB payloads, unchecked against frame_max, or very large message bodies to terminate consuming applications.

CVE-2026-131857.description: Supergateway 4.2.0 through 4.2.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in stdio-to-SSE mode that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the gateway via prototype-inherited sessionId values. Attackers can send a POST message request with sessionId set to toString or constructor, triggering an unhandled TypeError that terminates every attached MCP session.

CVE-2026-92182.description: Netgate pfSense CE XMLRPC Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Netgate pfSense. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the XMLRPC endpoint. The issue results from incorrect authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code within the context of the root. Was ZDI-CAN-32353.

CVE-2026-111801.description: An authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed authenticated users to read review-thread data from private repositories they could not access. An attacker required an authenticated account, a readable repository and pull request to use as the request context, and target review-thread identifiers. The thread-preview endpoint resolved supplied identifiers without restricting them to the authorized pull request, exposing private file paths and, when positioning and diff data were available, source-code excerpts, commit identifiers, and line metadata without victim interaction. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases in the 3.21, 3.22 series and was fixed in versions 3.21.10, 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-112740.description: A command injection vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated site administrator to execute arbitrary commands as the host git user on peer Git server nodes outside the pre-receive hook sandbox by supplying a crafted pre-receive environment download URL. Exploitation required a clustered deployment using custom pre-receive hook environments and at least one peer Git server node. This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.22.5, 3.21.10, 3.20.12, and 3.19.16. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-105929.description: A path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) was found in ansible-core's ansible-galaxy role installation. An explicit role "name" taken from a role's meta/requirements.yml is used to construct the on-disk installation path without validating that the resulting destination stays within the selected roles directory. A name containing "../" escapes that directory, and an absolute name replaces it entirely. Because ansible-galaxy processes transitive dependencies from an installed role's meta/requirements.yml, a malicious role publisher can cause attacker-supplied files to be written outside the operator's chosen roles directory when the operator installs the role, and, when --force is used, can cause an existing role directory outside that path to be removed and replaced. The impact is bounded by the invoking user's filesystem permissions and requires the operator to install the attacker-influenced content.

CVE-2026-106096.description: A flaw was found in CRI-O. When the optional Linux LinkLogs feature is enabled, the host pod log directory is bind-mounted into a pod emptyDir and is intended to be read-only, but Linux ignores MS_RDONLY on the initial bind and the CRI mount stays writable. A non-privileged UID 0 container can place a symlink at a future kubelet log path so that privileged conmon later appends attacker-controlled log data to an existing host file. This is an append-only host integrity issue, not universal remote code execution; LinkLogs is not enabled by default.

CVE-2026-110307.description: An incorrect authorization vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated user whose numeric user ID matched an enterprise's numeric ID to manage that enterprise's GitHub Apps and generate private keys without enterprise membership. GitHub App ownership checks compared numeric IDs without checking the owner's account type. Exploitation required control of a session for the colliding user account and an enterprise-owned GitHub App. A generated private key could be used to authenticate as the App and access repositories where it was installed, within its granted permissions. On standard fresh installations, the documented collision involved the non-loginable built-in ghost account; the reported GHES reproduction used site administrator impersonation. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-112115.description: An untrusted search path in ASUS Armoury Crate allows a local, low-privileged user to achieve privilege escalation by executing a crafted library at a high integrity level, via user-controlled environment settings inherited by an elevated process. Refer to the ' Security Update for Armoury Crate App ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-112117.description: A Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') in ASUS System Control Interface , allows a local, low-privileged user to gain full control over arbitrary existing files and folders outside the allowed directories via a crafted path containing dot-segment sequences that satisfies a folder prefix check, which can lead to unauthorized read and modification of protected files and may result in local privilege escalation. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS System Control Interface ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-114202.description: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote user to gain administrative privileges via a forged authentication token. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-114204.description: Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote user to bypass authentication by forging a session token for an account with a recent valid login, resulting in administrative control of the management console and of the clients it manages. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-114205.description: Incorrect authorization in ASUS Control Center Express allows a remote authenticated user with a low-privileged role to create an administrator account, resulting in administrative control of the management console and of the clients it manages. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Control Center Express Agent ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-116637.description: A site administrator could modify files on the appliance host with root privileges and disclose private repository data due to improper path validation in GitHub Enterprise Server. Exploitation required a crafted pre-receive hook environment. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server versions prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-116643.description: An SSH certificate authentication bypass vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated organization member to read and modify another user's private repositories within the trusted certificate authority's scope. Exploitation required an instance using built-in authentication and a valid certificate issued to the attacker by a trusted SSH certificate authority. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-119469.description: Incorrect default permissions in the ASUS DisplayWidget Center allow a local, low-privileged user to achieve arbitrary code execution in the security context of another user via a crafted executable placed in that user-writable directory, which the application launches when the other user runs it and uses a particular feature.Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Display Widget Center ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-126574.description: Missing authorization vulnerability in ASUS Control Center Datacenter and Control Center Enterprise allows remote authenticated users with a low-privileged Viewer role to change the password of an Administrator account, thereby obtaining administrative privileges, via a crafted password update request. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Control Center ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-131647.description: A CRLF injection vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed a user with write access to a repository to bypass branch protections and update branches or tags in that repository through specially crafted input when resolving pull request conflicts. This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-131820.description: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated user with repository write access to send requests to internal services through Slack webhook validity checks, potentially leading to remote code execution on the appliance. Exploitation required Secret Protection with secret scanning and validity checks for partner patterns enabled. This vulnerability affected all versions prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.22.5, 3.21.10, and 3.20.12. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-19399.description: Improper Authentication and Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') in ASUS Router firmware allow an unauthenticated nearby user to perform file operations or read files in an unintended directory via crafted HTTP requests during an active user session. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-88711.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command in certain ASUS Router firmware models allows an remote attacker to to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges by inducing a logged-in administrator to visit a malicious website. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-88760.description: Missing Authentication for Critical Function in certain ASUS Router firmware allows unauthenticated nearby users to obtain router information and resources (e.g., multimedia files) via HTTP requests. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-93458.description: Insertion of sensitive information into sent data in certain ASUS Router firmware allows a remote attacker to obtain router’s UID or login authorization tokens for the victim's linked account via a crafted web page, which requires a logged-in router administrator to actively complete the third-party authorization flow. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-93459.description: Use of externally-controlled format string in certain ASUS Router firmware allows a nearby administrator to read or write memory, potentially resulting in a denial-of-service, via crafted format specifiers sent to the logging/summary function. Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

CVE-2026-107949.description: A SQL injection vulnerability affects an administrative API in HCL Commerce versions 8, 9.0.1 and 9.1.0 - 9.1.21. A remote attacker with an administrative role could use a crafted URL to infer unauthorized data from the database.

CVE-2026-107950.description: An XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability affects a Storefront REST API in HCL Commerce versions 8, 9.0.1 and 9.1.x. A remote attacker, using a specially crafted XML, could potentially view internal files or consume memory resources.

CVE-2026-117634.description: Pleasanter contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in Publishing feature. If this vulnerability is exploited, a remote unauthenticated attacker who can access a site published using the product may obtain, by sending a specially crafted request, information on records of unpublished sites (e.g., titles), as well as the names of users, groups, and organizations registered in the same tenant. Note that the vulnerability only affects configurations where both of the following conditions are met: a site is published using the Publishing feature, and the published site contains link items (items linked to other sites, users, groups, or organizations).

CVE-2026-120472.description: A flaw was found in OpenShift Hive. The ClusterClaim controller assigns hive-claim-owner RBAC based on a user-controlled ClusterClaim.spec.namespace and only verifies ClusterPoolRef.ClaimName. A tenant can point a same-named claim at another tenant's ClusterDeployment and obtain get access to that cluster's admin kubeconfig and admin password secrets.

CVE-2026-121811.description: Pleasanter contains an issue with improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('Path Traversal') in the API. If this vulnerability is exploited, an arbitrary file on the server where the product is running may be obtained by a remote authenticated attacker.

CVE-2026-125276.description: Pleasanter contains an issue with insertion of sensitive information into sent data in the API. If the affected product receives a specially crafted API request sent by a remote authenticated attacker, the authentication credentials of other users, including administrators, such as API keys, may be obtained. As a result, the attacker may perform arbitrary operations on the affected product with the privileges associated with the obtained credentials.

CVE-2026-125411.description: Pleasanter contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the access control of Items. If this vulnerability is exploited, a remote authenticated attacker who can view records in the affected product may obtain the values of Items for which read access is restricted by Column access control. Note that the vulnerability affects configurations where read access conditions are set in Column access control settings.

CVE-2026-131800.description: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an organization member with permission to manage custom-property definitions and edit property values to add an attacker-controlled SSH authentication key to the personal account of another member through HTML stored in a single-select custom-property option. Exploitation required another definition manager in the same organization to attempt to remove the poisoned option while it was in use and save the definition with a valid sudo session. Repository access through the added key depended on the permissions of the victim and independent authorization controls. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

CVE-2026-131871.description: WLA DX 9.7 through 10.7 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in parse_data_blocks() in wlalink/analyze.c that copies section namespaces without length checks. Attackers can supply a crafted object or library file with a namespace longer than 255 bytes or unterminated to overflow the 256-byte stack buffer when linked.

CVE-2026-131872.description: SOIL2 before 1.4.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in its DDS, PVR and PKM image loaders that write results through unchecked caller-supplied output pointers. Attackers can supply a valid DDS, PVR or PKM file to applications passing NULL output pointers to SOIL_load_image or stbi_info, causing a crash.

CVE-2026-131873.description: Gargoyle 2023.1 through 2026.1.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the bundled Plus interpreter's ReadAction() function in terps/plus/loaddatabase.c, which never bounds-checks the index into the 1024-entry conditions array. Attackers can supply a crafted or truncated .plus game file with unterminated action conditions to write file-controlled values past the array and crash the player.

CVE-2026-131874.description: Gargoyle 2023.1 through 2026.1.1 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the bundled Plus interpreter's ReadString() function in terps/plus/loaddatabase.c that fails to handle end of file. Attackers can supply an empty, truncated, or crafted .plus game file that hangs Gargoyle at full CPU until the user kills it.

CVE-2026-131875.description: fqterm before 0.9.11 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in FQTermDecode that allows malicious servers to corrupt memory by sending CSI sequences with unbounded parameter indexes. Attackers controlling a telnet or SSH server, or intercepting cleartext telnet, can send over 30 semicolon-separated CSI parameters to write chosen 32-bit values past the decoder object on the heap.

CVE-2026-131876.description: fqterm 0.9.9 before 0.9.11 contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability in its SSH client that trusts unchecked server-supplied length fields for allocations, copies and read positions. Malicious servers or man-in-the-middle attackers can send crafted lengths in getString(), KEXINIT name-lists, key parsing or packet framing before host key verification to crash the client.

CVE-2026-101113.description: Multiple ELECOM wireless LAN routers contain an OS command injection vulnerability that may cause an arbitrary OS command to be executed by an attacker who can access the administrative interface of the affected product.

CVE-2026-130121.description: The AI Puffer - MCP Server for Claude & ChatGPT, with AI Chatbot plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via AI-generated comment replies in all versions up to, and including, 2.5.28 due to insufficient sanitization of the AI model's output in the insert_comment_reply_logic() function, which saves replies with wp_insert_comment() and bypasses the kses filtering WordPress normally applies to comment content. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page, by submitting a comment that leads the AI model to reproduce an HTML payload in its automated reply. This is only exploitable when an administrator has configured a Comment Auto-Reply automation task with 'Action on reply' set to 'Approve' (the default is 'Hold for moderation'), and the attacker's comment has been approved.

CVE-2026-130644.description: A path traversal flaw was found in ansible-core. When installing a collection with ansible-galaxy collection install, the install destination directory is derived from the namespace and name fields declared inside the collection artifact's own metadata, which are not validated as well-formed collection identifiers or checked for path containment. A malicious collection artifact -- delivered as a local file, a remote URL, a source directory, a git repository, or as a dependency -- can use a crafted name value to redirect the install destination outside the configured collections path, causing ansible-galaxy to delete an existing directory writable by the invoking user and then write attacker-controlled files to that location.

CVE-2026-117657.description: A Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information (CWE-319) vulnerability exists in the Android application "Imperial Palaces Guide" provided by The Imperial Household Agency. A man-in-the-middle attacker may be able to tamper with data transmitted between the application and the server, resulting in the display of modified content to users.

CVE-2026-118900.description: An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the Android application "Imperial Palaces Guide" provided by The Imperial Household Agency. An attacker may be able to execute arbitrary OS commands with the privileges of the application.

CVE-2026-104683.description: The Envira Gallery WordPress plugin before 1.16.4 does not apply its own gallery-permission policy until an administrator first opens its permissions screen, instead copying gallery-management capabilities onto each role from that role's core post capabilities after activation, which lets Contributor accounts create, edit and delete galleries that the policy is meant to restrict to higher roles.

CVE-2026-107099.description: The Royal Addons for Elementor WordPress plugin before 1.7.1071 does not restrict or validate the post meta keys used when counting or rendering a filtered grid, and does not reject private (hidden) meta keys, allowing unauthenticated users to disclose the value of arbitrary private post meta one value at a time from the filtered result count. This is an incomplete fix of CVE-2026-17585, whose 1.7.1067 patch covered only a separate search-based path and left the grid filtering path affected.

CVE-2026-107739.description: The Search & Replace WordPress plugin before 3.2.4 does not correctly restrict which database tables an administrator of a single site may operate on in a multisite network, allowing subsite administrators to read and modify the tables of other sites and of the network, and to make themselves Super Admin.

CVE-2026-107740.description: The Search & Replace WordPress plugin before 3.2.4 does not restrict one of its database tools to network administrators on multisite installations, allowing administrators of a single subsite to run arbitrary SQL against the whole network's database and make themselves Super Admin.

CVE-2026-111825.description: The Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'code' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload persists through WooCommerce session data into order-item metadata and executes when rendered in the ticket scanner interface.

CVE-2026-117489.description: The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not perform a capability or nonce check on an AJAX action available to authenticated users, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to disclose the name and content of non-public templates stored on the site.

CVE-2026-117491.description: The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not verify that the acting user is authorised to modify the target post when saving a template, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to overwrite the content and type of an arbitrary post, including another user's published page, removing it from the front end.

CVE-2026-117492.description: The Flatsome WordPress theme before 3.20.13 does not sanitise post meta saved through an AJAX action, nor escape it when rendering the product page, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor (who lack the unfiltered_html capability) to store JavaScript that executes in the browser of anyone who views the product, including administrators.

CVE-2026-117520.description: The Dynific Addons for Elementor (formerly Anywhere Elementor) WordPress plugin before 1.3.1 does not perform a capability check on an AJAX action that stores a configuration value, allowing any authenticated user, including Subscribers, to store a value that is later output without proper escaping in a quoted attribute on an administrator settings page, resulting in Stored Cross-Site Scripting that executes in the administrator's session.

CVE-2026-120390.description: The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.140 does not limit its table prefix rewrite to table names when restoring a database backup, which corrupts the length of stored serialized values and allows users with a role as low as Subscriber to plant a PHP object that WordPress instantiates after an administrator restores a backup.

CVE-2026-120391.description: The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.140 does not prevent serialized data it cannot safely unserialize from being re-serialized as a PHP object during a site migration, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to plant a PHP object that WordPress instantiates after an administrator restores a backup onto a different URL.

CVE-2026-120406.description: The Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 6.2.5 does not check that the post a form submission says it was sent from is publicly viewable before resolving post-related mail-tags, allowing unauthenticated users to obtain the title, URL, author name and author email of private, draft and trashed posts where such tags are used in an email or message returned to the submitter.

CVE-2026-123132.description: The Otter Blocks WordPress plugin before 3.2.10 does not use URL-aware escaping when it resolves its dynamic data tags inside HTML attributes, which could allow unauthenticated users to post comments containing links that execute arbitrary JavaScript when clicked, for example by a logged-in administrator.

CVE-2026-123662.description: The ProfilePress WordPress plugin before 4.18.1 does not atomically consume the source subscription when processing a membership plan change, allowing a customer to submit concurrent plan-change checkouts against a single paid subscription and obtain several active memberships for the price of one.

CVE-2026-126040.description: The Hide My WP Ghost WordPress plugin before 7.0.19 only enforces two-factor authentication on the interactive login flow and not on other authentication paths, allowing an attacker who already has a user's valid password to authenticate as that user without completing the second factor.

CVE-2026-126041.description: The Hide My WP Ghost WordPress plugin before 7.0.19 does not remove or restrict a debug branch in its output rewriting, allowing unauthenticated attackers to reveal the hidden login page, the hidden admin path and the renamed content folders the Hide My WP Ghost WordPress plugin before 7.0.19 is meant to conceal.

CVE-2026-127003.description: The RSVP and Event Management WordPress plugin before 2.7.19 does not sanitise and escape attendee data imported from a spreadsheet before outputting it on the frontend RSVP form, which could allow users with the Author role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against anyone, including administrators, viewing the affected attendee, even when the unfiltered_html capability is disallowed.

CVE-2026-127021.description: The Flamix: Bitrix24 and WooCommerce Products Sync WordPress plugin before 1.7.0 does not restrict or validate an unauthenticated file-exchange request, allowing anyone to write a file with an attacker-chosen name, extension and path to a web-served location and thereby execute arbitrary PHP.

CVE-2026-128851.description: The Probono Form Basic WordPress plugin before 1.3.3 does not validate the real type of files uploaded through its public form, trusting the client-declared MIME type instead, which could allow unauthenticated attackers to upload PHP files to a public directory and execute them before they are deleted, on servers that do not honour the Probono Form Basic WordPress plugin before 1.3.3's Apache-only access restriction.

CVE-2026-129434.description: The OneLogin SAML SSO WordPress plugin before 3.7.1 does not validate a user-supplied parameter before using it to redirect an already-authenticated user, allowing unauthenticated attackers to redirect a logged-in user to an arbitrary external domain via a crafted link (e.g. for phishing).

CVE-2026-5765.description: The Essential Real Estate plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.3 via deserialization of untrusted input in the 'saved_search_check_result' function. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to inject a PHP Object. No known POP chain is present in the vulnerable software, which means this vulnerability has no impact unless another plugin or theme containing a POP chain is installed on the site. If a POP chain is present via an additional plugin or theme installed on the target system, it may allow the attacker to perform actions like delete arbitrary files, retrieve sensitive data, or execute code depending on the POP chain present.

CVE-2026-75795.description: The Edwiser Bridge WordPress plugin before 4.3.5 does not correctly scope one of its REST API authentication checks, disabling WordPress's REST nonce validation for every route on the site, which allows attackers to make a logged-in administrator perform arbitrary privileged actions, such as creating a new administrator account, via CSRF.

CVE-2026-97329.description: The Team Members WordPress plugin before 5.4.2 does not properly escape a team member field when it is rendered back in the administration area, allowing users with the contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against higher-privileged users who edit the team.

CVE-2026-97330.description: The Team Members WordPress plugin before 5.4.2 does not properly escape team member social link URLs when they are rendered back in the administration area, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against higher privileged users who edit the team.

CVE-2026-131920.description: In OpenStack Cinder before 29.1.1, by making an os-initialize_connection request with an IQN that includes a path traversal as part of the connector's initiator element, an authenticated user with a 'member' role may create or overwrite files in the volume host filesystem. Only cinder-volume hosts using the LIO iSCSI target driver are affected. This target driver is typically used with the LVM volume driver.

CVE-2026-131922.description: In OpenStack keystonemiddleware before 13.0.3, by supplying a malicious regular expression when creating an application credential (aka AppCred) access_rules entry, an authenticated user may consume resources in the consuming process making a service unresponsive.

CVE-2026-1209.description: The BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data due to a misconfigured capability check on the 'update_item_permissions_check' function in all versions up to, and including, 14.4.0. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Author-level access and above, to enable and disable plugin components.

CVE-2026-2841.description: The Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to incorrect authorization in all versions up to, and including, 6.7.0. This is due to the 'ACF_Ajax_Query::get_args' method returning the user-supplied ''query' array directly without any key whitelisting or validation. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary query parameters to bypass field-configured role restrictions and exfiltrate sensitive user data including administrator email addresses, login names, and private user metadata via blind oracle techniques.

CVE-2025-15716.description: An incorrect implementation of authentication algorithm vulnerability in the SSO API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.2.2-72806-5 and 7.3.1-86003-1 (7.2.1-69057 is not affected) allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks with prior knowledge of the distinguished name (DN).

CVE-2025-2235.description: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability in OpenText™ Connected MX allows Privilege Escalation. The vulnerability could allow a local, low-privileged user of a macOS endpoint to gain root privileges through the Connected MX Agent update process. This issue affects Connected MX macOS Agent: before 25.2.

CVE-2026-125820.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Rymera Web Co Product Feed PRO for WooCommerce woo-product-feed-pro allows Object Injection.This issue affects Product Feed PRO for WooCommerce: from n/a through 13.5.8.

CVE-2026-125829.description: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Rymera Web Co Product Feed PRO for WooCommerce woo-product-feed-pro allows Path Traversal.This issue affects Product Feed PRO for WooCommerce: from n/a through 13.5.8.

CVE-2026-131959.description: GNU Emacs 31.1 contains a code injection vulnerability in its handling of directory-local variables. A crafted .dir-locals.el can supply a (REGEXP FUNCTION t) entry in auto-mode-alist; when a matching file is opened, Emacs calls FUNCTION before set-auto-mode--dir-local-valid-p validates it, executing arbitrary Emacs Lisp with the privileges of the Emacs process. (Emacs 30.2 is unaffected.)

CVE-2026-1212.description: The BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions up to, and including, 14.4.0. This is due to the `get_item_permissions_check` function in the Messages REST API endpoint trusting a client-supplied `user_id` parameter instead of using the authenticated user's ID. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access and above to read, update, or delete other users' private message threads by specifying the victim's user ID in the request.

CVE-2026-113497.description: A low-privileged remote attacker can change the password of arbitrary users using the REST API, including administrative accounts. By changing the administrator password, an attacker can obtain full administrative access to the device and modify all configuration settings.

CVE-2026-128981.description: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Improper Authentication in Apache SeaTunnel Web 1.0.2 allows a user whose account has been disabled to authenticate with valid credentials and obtain a new login token. The login query does not check the account status, so disabling an account does not prevent new logins or access to protected APIs using the newly issued token. This issue requires valid credentials for the disabled account; it is not a credential-free authentication bypass. Apache SeaTunnel Web is no longer maintained. The affected 1.0.2 release does not contain the account-status check added to the main branch in pull request #264. There is no maintained fixed release. Users should discontinue use of this unsupported component. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

CVE-2026-95643.description: Zohocorp Manageengine DDI Central build below 6500 are affected by a authenticated PowerShell command injection vulnerability in the Telnet connectivity feature, allowing specially crafted IPv6 scope identifiers to execute arbitrary commands on managed Windows nodes.

CVE-2026-95645.description: Zohocorp Manageengine DDI Central build below 6500 are affected by a authenticated command injection vulnerability in the Windows DDI Agent's clear_blocked_domains functionality, allowing specially crafted blocked-domain values to trigger arbitrary command execution on Windows systems.

CVE-2026-99312.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: KVM: x86: Unconditionally reset MMU context when emulating INIT Force an MMU reset when emulating an INIT even if paging was already disabled, as the MMU page role includes guest_mode (L2), i.e. an INIT while L2 is running with CR0.PG=0 will result in KVM running L1 with a stale MMU context. Alternatively, the reset could be scoped strictly to paging being enabled or L2 being active, but SMM is also encoded in the page role. Even though it _should_ be impossible for the vCPU to be INIT'd while SMM is active, there's zero value in not handling SMM. At that point, the only scenario where KVM _doesn't_ need to reset the MMU context is on an INIT with the vCPU running in Real Mode or Unpaged Protect Mode, and while INIT in those modes is somewhat common, it's far from a hot path and re-initializing the MMU is not expensive, especially when the role isn't changing (KVM elides most of the re-configuration in that case). Note, like the Fixes commit, this bug only affects nested SVM as INIT is an unconditional intercept on VMX, i.e. it's impossible to emulate INIT while L2 is active. Temporarily keep the guest TLB flush when CR0.PG is being cleared even though it is fully redundant with the flush that is emitted on all INIT events (KVM itself only does RESET when a vCPU is being created, i.e. when CR0.PG must be '0').

CVE-2026-99313.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: HID: logitech-hidpp: fix race condition when accessing stale stack pointer The driver uses hidpp->send_receive_buf to point to a stack-allocated buffer in the synchronous command path (__do_hidpp_send_message_sync). However, this pointer is not cleared when the function returns. If an event is processed (e.g. by a different thread) while the send_mutex is held by a new command, but before that command has updated send_receive_buf, the handler (hidpp_raw_hidpp_event) will observe that the mutex is locked and dereference the stale pointer. This results in an out-of-bounds access on a different thread's kernel stack (or a NULL pointer dereference on the very first command). Fix this by: 1. Clearing hidpp->send_receive_buf to NULL before releasing the mutex in the synchronous command path. 2. Moving the assignment of the local 'question' and 'answer' pointers inside the mutex_is_locked() block in the handler, and adding a NULL check before dereferencing.

CVE-2026-99314.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ALSA: us122l: Add missing NULL check in usb_stream_hwdep_mmap() usb_stream_hwdep_mmap() reads us122l->sk.s and dereferences it without checking for NULL. The stream object is released by usb_stream_free(), which is reached through us122l_stop() both when the device is disconnected and when us122l_start() fails, and it leaves us122l->sk.s set to NULL. The hwdep file stays usable after that, so a later mmap() KASAN: null-ptr-deref in range [0x0000000000000010-0x0000000000000017] RIP: 0010:usb_stream_hwdep_mmap+0x107/0x890 sound/usb/usx2y/us122l.c:182 crashes while reading s->read_size, which sits at offset 0x10. That NULL is an expected state for this field: usb_stream_hwdep_vm_fault(), usb_stream_hwdep_poll(), usb_stream_hwdep_ioctl(), usb_stream_stop() and usb_stream_free() all test it before use. Only the mmap callback misses the check, so let it return -ENODEV, matching what the other hwdep mapping in usx2yhwdeppcm.c does when its shared buffer has not been allocated.

CVE-2026-99315.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ALSA: us122l: Fix NULL dereference at hwdep open and release usb_stream_hwdep_open() and usb_stream_hwdep_release() pass the result of usb_ifnum_to_if() straight to usb_autopm_get_interface() and usb_autopm_put_interface(), without checking it for NULL. usb_ifnum_to_if() returns NULL once the device is gone, since usb_disable_device() clears udev->actconfig on disconnect. The hwdep file can outlive the disconnect: the card is released with snd_card_free_when_closed(), so a process that keeps the character device open reaches the driver's release callback after the USB configuration has been dropped, and interface_to_usbdev() then dereferences the NULL interface at offsetof(struct device, parent). The open callback has the same problem when it races with the disconnect. Check both lookups and fail the open with -ENODEV; in release, skip the runtime PM put when the interface is already gone and still run the rest of the per-file cleanup. Move the us122l->first bookkeeping after the checks so that a failed open no longer leaves a stale file pointer behind.

CVE-2026-99316.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ALSA: usx2y: Initialize idle URBs before submitting streams usb_stream_start() submits the first two capture and playback URBs and only afterwards assigns sk->idle_inurb, sk->idle_outurb, sk->completed_inurb and sk->completed_outurb to the remaining two URBs of each direction. A transfer can complete as soon as usb_submit_urb() has been called, so the completion handler i_capture_start() or i_playback_start() may run before those pointers are set. While the stream is still being synchronized (state below usb_stream_sync1), stream_start() then calls playback_prep_freqn(sk, sk->idle_outurb) with sk->idle_outurb still NULL, and the packet descriptors are written through that NULL pointer: Oops: general protection fault, probably for non-canonical address 0xdffffc0000000018: 0000 [#1] SMP KASAN KASAN: null-ptr-deref in range [0x00000000000000c0-0x00000000000000c7] RIP: 0010:playback_prep_freqn+0x11c/0x4a0 sound/usb/usx2y/usb_stream.c:33 Call Trace: <IRQ> stream_start+0x5dc/0x8d0 sound/usb/usx2y/usb_stream.c:596 i_capture_start+0x3da/0x710 sound/usb/usx2y/usb_stream.c:654 __usb_hcd_giveback_urb+0x238/0x550 drivers/usb/core/hcd.c:1657 usb_giveback_urb_bh+0x20b/0x530 drivers/usb/core/hcd.c:1691 tasklet_hi_action+0xa/0x20 kernel/softirq.c:994 handle_softirqs+0x16f/0x440 kernel/softirq.c:645 </IRQ> The four URBs referenced by these pointers are allocated long before and do not depend on any transfer state, so assign them before the submit loop. Keeping the assignment inside the retry path also restores a well-defined URB rotation when the start frame mismatch handling kills and resubmits the streams.

CVE-2026-99317.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ALSA: hwdep: Serialize DSP load requests The check of the loaded DSP indices and the call of the driver's dsp_load callback in snd_hwdep_dsp_load() are not serialized. A hwdep file descriptor can be shared among threads, or inherited across fork, so two SNDRV_HWDEP_IOCTL_DSP_LOAD requests for the same index can both observe the index as unloaded and enter the driver's callback concurrently, even though the device itself is opened exclusively. This breaks the assumption behind hw->dsp_loaded that a firmware index is loaded only once. For example, snd-usb-usx2y hits WARN_ON(usx2y->as04.buffer) in usx2y_async_seq04_init() and may allocate the US-428 sequence URBs twice. Serialize the check, the callback invocation and the bookkeeping with a per-hwdep mutex, so that the second request returns -EBUSY.

CVE-2026-99318.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ALSA: bcd2000: Fix use-after-free of MIDI URBs on file close bcd2000_disconnect() calls snd_card_disconnect(), which only prevents new opens, and then frees the MIDI URBs. A rawmidi file that was already open can still be closed afterwards, and its close callback, bcd2000_midi_output_close(), calls usb_kill_urb() on midi_out_urb. The URB pointers are cleared on disconnect and their accesses are serialized with midi_lock, but bcd2000_midi_output_close() reads midi_out_urb without that lock. The check can therefore pass just before the pointer is cleared, and usb_kill_urb() then runs on the URB that has already been freed: BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in usb_kill_urb+0x74/0x80 Read of size 8 at addr ffff8880078e7d40 usb_kill_urb bcd2000_midi_output_close close_substream rawmidi_release_priv snd_rawmidi_release Allocated by: usb_alloc_urb <- bcd2000_init_midi <- bcd2000_probe Freed by: usb_free_urb <- bcd2000_midi_free <- bcd2000_disconnect Take the lock in bcd2000_midi_output_close() and reference the URB with usb_get_urb() before releasing it. The URB then stays valid until usb_put_urb() after usb_kill_urb() has returned, even if a disconnect frees it in the meantime. usb_kill_urb() itself cannot run under midi_lock, as the completion handler takes the same lock.

CVE-2026-99319.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ALSA: usx2y: Refuse a retried DSP load after a failure snd_usx2y_hwdep_dsp_load() sets up the asynchronous sequence URBs and the interrupt URB when the FPGA firmware image with index 1 is loaded, and then creates the ALSA devices. If usx2y_in04_init() or usx2y_create_alsa_devices() fails, the URBs that were already set up are left in place. The core keeps the index unloaded when the callback fails, so user space may issue the same request again. The second attempt then enters usx2y_async_seq04_init() or usx2y_in04_init() with the URBs still allocated and trips WARN_ON(usx2y->as04.buffer) or WARN_ON(usx2y->in04_urb). The URBs cannot be released at this point: the card may already have registered PCM devices that user space can still open, and the disconnect handler accesses the URBs without holding the DSP lock. Mark the chip as hung instead, so that a retried request is refused with -ENODEV and the assertions keep their meaning. The URBs are released by snd_usx2y_card_private_free() when the card is freed. A failing usx2y_async_seq04_init() still releases its own URBs, so that path remains retryable.

CVE-2026-110513.description: Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server HTTP transport. A self-issued JSON Web Token (JWT) identified the user only by numeric user ID, and a new user takes the lowest free ID. After an administrator deleted a user, that user's unexpired token, or a token refreshed from it while the ID was free, authenticated as the next account created with that ID and had that account's permissions. Only deployments with HTTP enabled are affected. This issue affects Apache Iggy: through 0.9.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-112213.description: Out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the pixReadMemJp2kCore() function in Leptonica, located in jp2kio.c. The function retrieves the output dimensions only for component 0 and uses a common index to iterate through the buffers of all components. If the remaining components have smaller dimensions, the traversal exceeds the bounds of their sample buffers, which are allocated by OpenJPEG. When processing a specially crafted JPEG 2000 image, data read from adjacent dynamic memory may be incorporated into the pixels of the decoded image and result in information disclosure to anyone who can access the output.

CVE-2026-120557.description: The WP Delicious – Recipe Plugin for Food Bloggers (formerly Delicious Recipes) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'details[].icon' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.10.11 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload bypasses wp_kses_post on save because Gutenberg serializes block attribute JSON with JSON_HEX_QUOT, encoding double-quotes as \u0022 so no raw quote or angle bracket appears in post_content; parse_blocks() restores the literal quote at render time, producing the HTML attribute breakout.

CVE-2026-120566.description: The WP Delicious – Recipe Plugin for Food Bloggers (formerly Delicious Recipes) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'recipeTitle' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.10.10 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. WordPress core's block-attribute kses pass strips HTML tags but preserves bare double-quote characters, allowing a payload such as x" onerror="alert(1) to survive both the save pipeline and the render-time strip_tags() call, breaking out of the alt attribute of the rendered img element.

CVE-2026-120672.description: The Meow Gallery plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'limit' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.5.9 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

CVE-2026-123343.description: The BlockArt Blocks – Gutenberg Blocks, Page Builder Blocks ,WordPress Block Plugin, Sections & Template Library plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.4.3. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to view the title, excerpt, and full content of other users' draft, pending, and private posts, exposing that content to unauthenticated visitors on the published permalink. This is exploitable by an Author-level user because WordPress's wp_filter_post_kses preserves block-comment JSON in HTML comments, allowing the malicious queryArgs and query[post_status] attributes to survive post saving and execute on every unauthenticated request to the published URL. Exploitation by attackers with contributor-level access and above requires that attacker only needs to see the data themselves (not expose it to unauthenticated visitors) — satisfied by viewing their own preview URL. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with author-level access and above.

CVE-2026-125012.description: The Flying Images: Optimize and Lazy Load Images for Faster Page Speed plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.4.16 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Although wp_kses_post sanitizes post content on save, the payload is kses-legal at save time; the plugin's output-buffer rewrite transforms it into an executable form at render time by overwriting the valueless data-src attribute with the unescaped src value, meaning save-time sanitization provides no effective mitigation.

CVE-2026-125058.description: The Image Source Control Lite – Show Image Credits and Captions plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'meta[isc_image_licence]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.14.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The licence display feature must be enabled in the plugin settings (enable_licences option), which is a standard configuration for sites using the licence-attribution functionality.

CVE-2026-126708.description: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.0.0 to 2.0.22 and 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, the return value of password hash functions for sha512-pbkdf2 and legacy sha512 were not checked. Starting with OpenSSL 4.0, sha512-pbkdf2 hashing will fail when using the FIPS provider for passwords shorter than 8 characters. This has the effect that newly created passwords would match against any other password with fewer than 8 characters.

CVE-2026-129509.description: In the Apache Airflow Microsoft Azure provider 10.2.0 through 15.3.0, `S3ToAzureBlobStorageOperator` turned off TLS certificate verification for its connection to Amazon S3 by default (`s3_verify=False`), whatever the AWS connection's own verification settings were. An attacker positioned on the network between an Airflow worker and S3 could intercept that traffic, read the signed requests and alter the listed object keys and the copied file contents. Deployments are affected when a Dag uses `S3ToAzureBlobStorageOperator` without setting `s3_verify`. Users are advised to upgrade to apache-airflow-providers-microsoft-azure 15.3.1 or later, which uses the AWS connection's verification settings by default.

CVE-2026-129705.description: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, a broker with a listener that is configured to use the PROXY protocol v2 is vulnerable to an untrusted proxy providing details that cause the broker to accept fake SSL information. This can be mitigated by following the documented requirements for PROXY listeners: It is very important that only trusted proxies are allowed to connect to any listener using the PROXY protocol, and that clients are not allowed to connect to the listener at all.

CVE-2026-130491.description: In Eclipse versions 1.5-1.6.13, 2.0.0-2.0.22 and 2.1.0-2.1.2, the client library libmosquitto does not reject Will messages with payloads greater than 65535 bytes when calling `mosquitto_will_set()` or `mosquitto_will_set_v5()`. This results in up to 65535 bytes of uninitialised heap memory being transmitted as the Will. This can be mitigated by only passing payloads with a maximum length of 65535 bytes.

CVE-2026-19707.description: A bug in the Airlock Gateway (8.5.2 and earlier, and 8.6.0) allows attacker-controlled HTML in a backend response to exploit the Smart Form Protection feature, possibly leading to a Denial of Service (DoS) or Remote Code Execution (RCE) attack against the Airlock Gateway. The issue has been fixed in Airlock Gateway version 8.5.3 and 8.6.1. For an attack to be executable, the Airlock Gateway needs to have 'Smart Form Protection' (or the corresponding expert settings) enabled on a mapping whose backend returns a response containing certain multi-byte HTML character references. The buffer overflow then happens during the parsing of that HTML response. Such a response can come either from a malicious or compromised backend, or from an otherwise trusted backend that returns attacker-supplied HTML, e.g. an application that stores and serves plain user-provided HTML files. Successfully exploiting the vulnerability can enable an attacker to perform a DoS attack or, in the worst case, an RCE attack against the Airlock Gateway in front of the affected backend. Compromising the functionality of the Airlock Gateway could in this way also affect the availability and protection of other well-intentioned backends deployed behind the same Gateway.

CVE-2026-1214.description: The BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 14.5.0. This is due to missing authorization checks in the `bp_nouveau_ajax_get_single_activity_content` AJAX handler. The function only verifies a nonce that is publicly exposed to any visitor who loads a BuddyPress page, but does not call `bp_activity_user_can_read()` to verify the user has permission to view the activity. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read private group activity content by iterating activity IDs.

CVE-2026-58320.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server. The system snapshot command (GetSnapshot on the binary transports and POST /snapshot on HTTP) checked only that the caller was logged in, not the read_servers or manage_servers permission. Any authenticated user, including a user with no permissions, could download a diagnostic archive with the server log files, the host process list, a file system listing and the runtime server configuration. The runtime configuration contains the HTTP JWT signing secret and the message encryption key when they are set in the configuration. If HTTP is enabled, the user could use the signing secret to create tokens for any account, including root. This issue affects Apache Iggy: before 0.9.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-110486.description: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1 through 2.1.2, a listener configured with `protocol websockets` mishandles empty WebSocket data frames. `net__read_ws()` in `lib/net_ws.c` returns the number of framing bytes consumed (the 4 masking-key bytes) for a data frame with a zero-length payload, without writing any bytes to the caller’s buffer. The MQTT packet reader in `packet__read_single()` (`lib/packet_mosq.c`) trusts that return value as a payload byte count. A remote client can therefore advance the read position over an uninitialised heap allocation, causing the broker to process and forward uninitialised heap memory (information disclosure, including heap and libc pointers), and can underflow the unsigned `to_process` counter so that subsequent attacker-controlled frame data is written past the end of the allocation (heap out-of-bounds write). The out-of-bounds write is reachable from the CONNECT packet before any authentication check, so an unauthenticated client can corrupt the heap and crash the broker even when `allow_anonymous false` is set. Combining the disclosure and the write allows remote code execution as the broker’s user by any client able to establish a session.

CVE-2026-126706.description: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, the mosquitto_ctrl utility would crash if attempting to interact with a hostile broker and the broker sent a non-string "error" value.

CVE-2026-129149.description: In Eclipse Mosquitto versions 2.1.0 to 2.1.2, using the mosquitto_ctrl utility in interactive shell mode to interact with a malicious server could result in a crash of the utility if the server sent a hostile response.

CVE-2026-132049.description: A flaw was found in lldpd. The service fails to verify that Link Layer Discovery Protocol - Media Endpoint Discovery (LLDP-MED) location records received from network neighbors match their declared lengths. An adjacent attacker on the local network can exploit this flaw by sending crafted packets, causing client applications using the liblldpctl library to read past buffer boundaries when parsing location data. This issue can lead to an information disclosure of adjacent process memory.

CVE-2026-132069.description: MISP (Malware Information Sharing Platform) contains an authorization bypass in the SharingGroup model's captureSGExisting method. The authorization check used a logical AND condition that effectively exempted users with the sync permission (perm_sync) from the membership verification. Specifically, the original condition 'if (!checkIfAuthorised(...) && !perm_sync) return false' meant that any user holding the sync role would pass the check regardless of whether they were actually a member of the target sharing group. A sync user who knows or can discover the UUID of a non-local sharing group could exploit this flaw through the /sharing_groups/add endpoint or by embedding a SharingGroup object in pushed sync data. The attacker could rewrite the sharing group record to add their own organisation as a member or insert an all_orgs server entry for their MISP instance, thereby gaining read access to all events contained in that group. This exposes threat intelligence data that was intended to be restricted to the group's legitimate members. The vulnerability requires an authenticated account with the sync role and knowledge of a valid sharing group UUID. No user interaction is required. The impact is unauthorized disclosure of shared threat intelligence events and limited integrity modification of the sharing group record.

CVE-2026-87850.description: nVision sends user's token via query parameters of GET requests. An attacker who obtains valid token can gain access to the victim's account and perform actions on their behalf. This issue was fixed in version 18.

CVE-2026-100181.description: The Asset CleanUp: Page Speed Booster plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.0.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit succeeds even though wp_kses is applied on save, because the XSS is manufactured post-sanitization by the plugin's regex pass: kses-permitted tags such as <a title> and <code> carry the attacker's marker and terminator strings intact into the rendered HTML buffer, where the plugin's own replacement then corrupts the document structure.

CVE-2026-105328.description: The Delivery & Pickup Date Time for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 1.3.90. This is due to a nonce-only settings AJAX handler that stores an attribute-breaking value and an administrator settings template that outputs it without HTML attribute escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-107494.description: The QUIC stack queues a RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame also for retransmitted NEW_CONNECTION_ID frames. This allows a remote malicious QUIC stack to queue an unlimited number of RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frames.

CVE-2026-109235.description: The WP Maps – Google Maps, OpenStreetMap, Mapbox, Store Locator with Search, Filters & Listings plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'csv_columns' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.0.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

CVE-2026-111371.description: The SchemaEngine AI – AI Schema Markup, Reviews & Rich Snippets for SEO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content/excerpt (REST wp/v2/posts) → stored in post_content/post_excerpt' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A Contributor's entity-encoded payload survives save-time wp_kses filtering verbatim and is only decoded into raw script tags at render time via html_entity_decode(), meaning the injected script executes for every visitor — including authenticated Administrators — once an Editor publishes the post through the standard Contributor workflow.

CVE-2026-111508.description: Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. Exploitation could lead to arbitrary command execution with root privileges on the appliance.

CVE-2026-115684.description: In specific versions of Octopus Tentacle, Tentacle fails to unset registration credentials as environment variables, resulting in deployment scripts potentially having the ability to read those credentials.

CVE-2026-116530.description: The Check & Log Email – Easy Email Testing & Mail logging plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.17 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires an administrator to approve the comment carrying the shortcode payload, and the target page must render the core Latest Comments block, which passes comment author names through do_shortcode via the_content.

CVE-2026-116536.description: The Custom Twitter Feeds – A Tweets Widget or X Feed Widget plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'atts (JSON object, specifically the inner `feed` key)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.11.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected payload is first stored in the wp_ctf_feed_caches database table and later written into the ctf_cron_report WordPress option by the scheduled ctf_feed_update cron job, meaning execution is deferred until the cron runs and an administrator subsequently loads the Support page.

CVE-2026-118493.description: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server. If Apache Iggy 0.9.0 started without IGGY_ROOT_USERNAME and IGGY_ROOT_PASSWORD, it generated a root password and wrote it to the server log file, which is enabled by default. The system snapshot command (GetSnapshot on the binary transports and POST /snapshot on HTTP) let a user with only the read_servers permission download the server log files. That user could read the generated root password and log in as root. This issue affects Apache Iggy: 0.9.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue. Version 0.10.0 never generates a root password, and the snapshot requires the manage_servers permission. If a 0.9.0 server generated its root password, change that password.

CVE-2026-118519.description: The DataPress (Dataverse Integration) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 2.97 via the 'src' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information. Exploitation requires WP_DEBUG to be defined as true on the target site — not the default on production, but commonly enabled on staging, development, and misconfigured production environments.

CVE-2026-119161.description: The HTML Forms – Simple WordPress Forms Plugin plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'arbitrary POST parameter NAME (the array key, not the value)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping.
